title: Provider evidence units must match the current Invest v1 Tushare adapter contract
context: Provider evidence already required CNY currency, core interface names, positive rows and adapter-required fields, but price_unit, volume_input_unit, volume_output_unit and timezone were only required to be nonempty. A semantically wrong unit declaration could therefore participate in provider-side readiness.

decision.future_provider_behavior: version or extend the evidence contract rather than silently changing v1 unit semantics

scope_note: This closes a credential-free unit-semantics evidence gap only. It does not prove provider permission, market-data completeness, any boundary, strategy profitability or holdout readiness.
